state.objective: Diagnose 5-second latency spikes in Go service running on Alpine Linux.

context.content:
nameserver 10.96.0.10
search default.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local
options ndots:5

submitted_answer.answer: The 5-second spikes are consistent with musl parallel A/AAAA DNS queries reusing a source port and encountering conntrack drops.
